evals.prompt: Use an-dr-dev-implement-pipeline. Set up CI and a tagged release pipeline for this project.
evals.context: A Rust command-line tool hosted on GitHub, with cargo tests, documented in its README, and no workflow files yet.
expected_behavior: Derives the CI steps from the commands the repository actually uses, runs them on pushes and pull requests, and does not invent extra stages.
Does not push a tag, publish a release, or add a secret, and states that the pipeline has not been proven until it runs on the platform.
